title: xerodraba lycopodioides

This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to fully understand the plant's chemical composition and medicinal potential.
